name: Mathesar
description: Mathesar is a spreadsheet-like web interface for PostgreSQL. Users of any technical skill level can view, edit, query and collaborate on Postgres data directly, build relationships between tables, import CSV files and create forms, while access is governed by native PostgreSQL roles and privileges.

notes.text: The first visit asks you to create the admin account. Its two analytics checkboxes are ticked by default; untick them if you do not want to share usage data.
The bundled PostgreSQL only holds Mathesar's own database. Choose 'Create a new database' for your data, or connect to an existing PostgreSQL 14+ server.
Behind a reverse proxy, set ALLOWED_HOSTS in /opt/mathesar_data/.env to your domain instead of * and forward the Host and X-Forwarded-Proto headers.
